settings.heading: Why the dose and the press matter

settings.subtitle_text: Pumpkin seed oil tackles every stage of hair loss from the inside out.

settings.item_1_content:
The shedding stage — what you notice first:

  • Hair falling out in the shower or on your pillow
  • Thinning at the crown or parting line
  • Noticeably less volume over time
  • DHT overproduction shrinking your follicles
settings.item_2_content:
The thinning stage — when density starts to drop:

  • Fine, limp hair that lacks body
  • Wider parting line becoming visible
  • Ponytail noticeably thinner in circumference
  • Follicles producing weaker, shorter strands
settings.item_3_content:
The stalled stage — when follicles stop producing:

  • Hair not growing past a certain length
  • Bald patches that haven't recovered
  • Hairline recession with no regrowth
  • Dormant follicles no longer producing hair
